name: visual-teaching

# Visual Teaching

Read [visual patterns](./visual-patterns.md).

## Procedure
1. Identify what is invisible or hard to imagine.
2. Decide what single relationship the visual must reveal.
3. Choose the simplest visual form that exposes it.
4. Label only what supports the teaching point.
5. Pair the visual with a prediction or observation question when possible.
6. Add a debrief explaining what the viewer should notice.

## Rule
Do not request decorative graphics when a diagram, curve, table, trace, or animation would teach more effectively.
